basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and science enthusiast based in the Midwest. I'm a part-time lab technician by day and a strategy game junkie by night. I split my time between my work, exploring the latest in gaming tech, and indulging in my love for Doritos. Currently single, I enjoy the laid-back lifestyle and often spend evenings playing Total War games. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 11 PM to 2 AM, after work and gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possess a solid foundation in biology and chemistry, thanks to a bachelor's degree in Biochemistry. My job in a research lab further solidifies my expertise, giving me practical insights into microbiology. I stay updated through online courses and forums.
